en-US.description:
Lady Jo, who lost both her father and father-in-law due to the war.

However, the family she had to lose was not the end of it.

The Mongol civil war, which spilled over even into Goryeo—a conflict not found in textbooks—what other tragedies did this war bring about?

How did Lady Jo live on after the war ended?

In this session, we will discuss this aspect.

The textbook states that the Baekje Revival Movement failed due to internal division, and Heukchi Sangji's subsequent activities are not mentioned.
What happened to Heukchi Sangji after that? The textbook ends with this question left unanswered.
